text: GSLRD[p,n,nb] denotes the perpendicular component in the lightcone decomposition of the slashed Dirac matrix (\gamma \cdot p) along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \((\gamma \cdot p)_{\perp}\).
Overview, DiracGamma, GALPD, GALND, GALRD, GSLPD, GSLND.
StandardForm[GSLRD[p, n, nb] // FCI] (*DiracGamma[LightConePerpendicularComponent[Momentum[p, D], Momentum[n, D], Momentum[nb, D]], D]*)
GSLRD[p, n, nb] . GSLPD[q, n, nb] // DiracSimplify

\[-\frac{1}{4} n^2 (\text{nb}\cdot q) (\gamma \cdot \;\text{nb}).\left(\gamma \cdot p_{\perp }\right)-\frac{1}{4} (n\cdot \;\text{nb}) (\text{nb}\cdot q) (\gamma \cdot n).\left(\gamma \cdot p_{\perp }\right)\]
